mentions.name: t41-pluto
mentions.description: This project reverse-engineers the neural network accelerator (NNA) inside a Chinese WiFi camera SoC and implements an ONNX compiler and runtime so custom models can run on it, turning the hardware into a $20 AI smart camera.
mentions.source_excerpt: I spent some with reverse-engineering a neural network accelerator (NNA) inside a Chinese WiFi camera SoC: https://github.com/inoop/t41-pluto. I used Claude to reverse-engineer the hardware, and then implement an ONNX compiler and runtime so I can run my own models. Basically I now have a $20 AI smart camera.
